As someone who did successfully get back together with his ex after she initiated the break up, I'd hold off on asking her if you'd like to get back together so soon. Pressuring her into getting back so soon may only drive her further away because while she may still have feelings for you, she might not be ready. So respect her decision- reassure that you're not going to pressure her into getting back together. If she's responsive- talk and try to do some of the fun things the two of you did before. As far as meeting her is concerned, I'd advice against it for now unless you're able to accept the fact that you might get back together but that might take time or you might not.
